body:
> Why is the `href` in your example https://www.algolia.com/users/sign_in instead of the link you want to go to? e.g. if the url you put in Algolia are complete urls, then do:
> 
> ```
> <a href="{{href}}">
> ```
> 
> or whatever the name of the attribute is. If the URL is relative, then:
> 
> ```
> <a href="https://base.com/{{path}}">
> ```
> 
> Is that what you meant?

@Haroenv - Yes i tried the same. But this works when i create my template of hit js

```
instantsearch.widgets.hits({
	container: '#hits',
	escapeHTML: false,
	templates: {
		item: "**Hit design**"
```

But when I create my **Hit design** (template) in another Html file within the script tags, and accessing that as given below It does not work.


```
instantsearch.widgets.hits({
	container: '#hits',
	escapeHTML: false,
	templates: {
item :document.getElementById('hit-template-row').innerHTML
```
